overview: Egypt's femtech scene is small but distinctive, led by consumer platforms tackling reproductive, menstrual and maternal health in Arabic, a space long constrained by cultural taboos. MotherBeing (with its AI assistant Daleela) and menstrual-health apps Aziza and LittleBits anchor a founder base that is heavily women-led, while maternal-care apps like MammyApp and Mammy target pregnancy support. Capital remains thin and mostly comes via pan-African and MENA gender-lens vehicles (Madica, Flat6Labs and Organon's accelerator) rather than dedicated local funds. Large-scale impact still flows through government initiatives and NGO coalitions rather than venture-backed startups.

sections.heading: Latest major news
sections.narrative: Recent movement centres on funding for adjacent health tech, femtech product launches and NGO-backed maternal programs.

items.text: Egyptian teleradiology startup Rology closes an undisclosed growth round backed by Philips Foundation, J&J Impact Ventures, Sanofi Impact and MIT Solve to scale AI diagnostics across MEA.
MotherBeing secures up to USD 200,000 from Flourish Ventures' pan-African fund Madica, part of an USD 800,000 round expanding into North Africa.
Pathfinder International joins the Every Pregnancy coalition to pilot 'Stronger Mothers, Healthier Babies', tackling maternal malnutrition in Egypt via multiple micronutrient supplementation.
MotherBeing launches Daleela, a culturally-aware bilingual AI health assistant for Arabic-speaking women covering menstruation, sexual health and fertility.
Organon and Flat6Labs close the second edition of the MENAT Women's Health Accelerator, with eight startups including Egyptian teams presenting at Demo Day.
Egypt explores a specialised biotech and digital-health investment fund with Gold Rock Venture, targeting high-impact health innovation across North Africa.

sections.heading: Policy & strategy
sections.narrative: Government strategy prioritises population management, maternal health and mass women's screening, with strong UNFPA and EU support.

items.text: Presidential '100 Million Healthy Lives' women's health initiative launches, offering free breast-cancer and reproductive screening; over 71 million visits logged since.
Egypt's National Population and Development Strategy 2023-2030 sets family-planning and reproductive-health targets, backed by EU and UNFPA.
Ministry of Health launches a new maternal and child health initiative including a mobile app for pregnant women and nationwide awareness campaign.

sections.heading: Latest ecosystem moves
sections.narrative: Support structures for women's health are largely accelerator-led and pan-regional rather than dedicated local funds.

items.text: Flat6Labs and Organon run the MENAT Women's Health Accelerator for femtech startups in family planning, wellness and fertility, now in its second edition.
Madica (Flourish Ventures) expands into North Africa with a portfolio targeting 50%+ gender diversity, backing Egypt's MotherBeing.
Merck Egypt supports femtech programs via introductions to healthcare stakeholders to help startups pilot and scale across Egypt and MENA.
Egypt weighs a dedicated biotech, medical-device and digital-health investment fund with Gold Rock Venture.
